text: Reverse mathematics studies which axioms are necessary to prove theorems. The base system RCA₀ corresponds to:
choices: recursive comprehension and Σ⁰₁ induction — provably equivalent to computable mathematics
explanation: RCA₀ (recursive comprehension axioms): the base system of reverse mathematics. Corresponds to computable mathematics. Four stronger systems (WKL₀, ACA₀, ATR₀, Π¹₁-CA₀) form the 'big five'.
